theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_fli_integral_canonical_domination
theorems.statement: (∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), IsIntegral V → ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (k : ℝ≥0∞)) → (∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight x θ ∧ 0 < θ) → ∃ θ : Euclidean N → ℝ, IsVarifoldOf V {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'} θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'}, (∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane V x T (θ x)) ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) ∧ ∀ Z ⊆ {x | x ∈ V.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ'}, V.weight Z = 0 → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) Z = 0) → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (W : Varifold N n U), IsIntegral W → W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → ∃ θ : Euclidean N → ℝ, IsVarifoldOf W {x | x ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane W x T θ'} θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ {x | x ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane W x T θ'}, (∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane W x T (θ x)) ∧ HasDensity n W.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) {x | x ∈ {x | x ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane W x T θ'} ∧ ¬ ∃ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m ∧ θ x = m} = 0 ∧ ∀ (K : Set (Euclidean N)) (u : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → Measurable u → (∀ x, x ∉ K → u x = 0) → ∫⁻ x, u x ∂W.weight ≤ ∫⁻ x in {x | x ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ' : ℝ), HasTangentPlane W x T θ'} ∩ K, u x * ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))
